• Night Mode: one-tap button beside Audio/Subtitles. Native-MPV compression softens loud peaks and helps quiet dialogue. Stays enabled globally until you switch it off.
• Extra Brightness: in-player video-only slider (0–80), live preview and Reset. Remembers your setting across movies and restarts; never changes monitor backlight.
• Both iOS 15 TrollStore and Windows x64 use the same Flutter player and native MPV settings. Some video/audio outputs may limit effects.
